labels_policy: Labels separate kinds of warrant, not ordinal probabilities; no equality follows from several unresolved actualities. Record acceptance is methodological, not acceptance of metaphysical truth.

component_assessments.record_reliability: Selected Chalmers/Papineau attributions are reliable within inspected texts; they disagree about inference, not simply the existence of a debate.
component_assessments.inference_strength: Modal/fundamentality and PSR/mental-ground routes are substantive conditional arguments, not two independent observations. Identity is a developed counterproposal, not established by intervention alone.
component_assessments.component_confidence: Contested positive philosophical motivation; actuality unresolved
component_assessments.reason: The phenomenal target is a serious explanatory demand. A modal gap-to-ontology bridge and the further choice of basic rather than strongly emergent experience remain disputed. A required ultimate explanation does not by itself identify an experiential ground.

component_assessments.record_reliability: Kastrup text and selected combination/decomposition arguments are supported attributions; underlying clinical illustrations and rival original chains are incomplete.
component_assessments.inference_strength: RT-T16-U-GROUND contains a ground and individuation premise partly specifying the conclusion. Coherent unification is a potential explanatory gain, not independent confirmation of the universal subject.
component_assessments.component_confidence: Conditional explanatory proposal; no discriminating actuality warrant
component_assessments.reason: A common conscious ground could unify experience and shared lawfulness, but fundamentality does not identify one subject or conscious whole. Individuation and constrained neural mapping are additional burdens.

component_assessments.record_reliability: Study counts and reported technical disputes are supported records; event truth and patient-specific absence of processing are not equivalently established. AWARE II target opportunity intersection remains unknown.
component_assessments.inference_strength: No inspected named-case route establishes the full REPORTTRUE/TIMELOCK/EXCLUSION/BMAP chain. Neural manipulation gives positive support to local brain contributions under proxies, but brain influence is not the negation of every independence model.
component_assessments.component_confidence: Unresolved extracerebral acquisition; positive evidence for embodied neural contribution
component_assessments.reason: Specific reports merit investigation, but independently fixed acquisition time and relevant process/information exclusion are missing. Prospective recruitment improves ascertainment without making recollection a real-time neural measurement.

component_assessments.record_reliability: Identity authors are inspected attributions and case reports retain their narrow reliability; neither is a verified beyond-death observation.
component_assessments.inference_strength: DEATH plus SAME are conditions specifying much of the target. Their conjunction explains what must be shown; no independent empirical increment follows from assuming them.
component_assessments.component_confidence: Not established by this corpus; additional endpoint and identity gaps
component_assessments.reason: Even verified unusual acquisition in a resuscitated person would not establish same-person subjectivity beyond irreversible death. Identity criteria yield different required evidence.

component_assessments.record_reliability: Time-model and philosophical attributions are supported at their limited domains; duration reports are reports of phenomenology.
component_assessments.inference_strength: TIMELESS/GROUND/INDIV build a model rather than discover its actuality. The NOW challenge depends on objective changing presentness and what knowledge requires; it is not a contradiction in every timeless model.
component_assessments.reason: A non-successive foundation with temporal persons is conditionally intelligible. Tensed knowledge poses a conditional challenge; altered duration and physics models do not establish an actual timeless bearer.

component_assessments.record_reliability: The distinction is accepted conceptual analysis, not observation of a universal store.
component_assessments.inference_strength: STORE states the needed bearer and actual persistence. H-S implies narrow H-P if established; reversing that implication is invalid.
component_assessments.component_confidence: Preservation distinctions supported; cosmic preservation actuality unresolved
component_assessments.reason: Records, value, relations and continued subjectivity are distinct targets. Same-person survival entails narrow preservation of that subjectivity, but finite records do not establish cosmic or permanent preservation.

component_assessments.record_reliability: Selected order/selection and purpose arguments are accepted attributions/analysis; no measured likelihood of a designer choosing life is in the corpus.
component_assessments.inference_strength: CANDIDATE plus EXPECT permits a conditional abductive comparison, not deductive agency. Defenders offer qualitative comparisons, but their preference and selection assumptions remain contested; no defensible quantitative prior/likelihood specification in this corpus supports a numerical posterior.
component_assessments.component_confidence: Conditional explanatory value; differential evidential support uncalibrated
component_assessments.reason: A specified intention can explain a cosmic role if an actual agent and grounding relation exist. Order and conscious life alone do not identify intention; preference and observation-selection assumptions do material work.

component_assessments.record_reliability: Rowe, Adams, Sutherland, Schellenberg and Howard-Snyder claims are inspected selected attributions. Howard-Snyder 1996 and Schellenberg 2025 are not a direct exchange.
component_assessments.inference_strength: Evil/hiddenness are defeasible and attribute-sensitive challenges. GOOD/RESTORE in the defense assume rather than independently establish goodness/restoration. Unrestricted unknown-reasons defenses can also weaken positive recognition of goodness.
component_assessments.component_confidence: Rich perfect-governance package faces substantive conditional challenges; bare goodness unresolved
component_assessments.reason: Suffering and nonresistant nonbelief challenge specified power/knowledge/perfect-love packages. Restorative coherence addresses victims final loss only if actual same-person restorative goods occur, and does not alone justify permitting harm.

component_assessments.record_reliability: Selected author attributions and descriptive/normative distinctions are reliable; missing constructivist and non-naturalist originals block comprehensive elimination claims.
component_assessments.inference_strength: AUTH partly specifies the target relation. Shared subjecthood, creator status, sanctions and power alone do not supply it. Rival explanatory availability challenges uniqueness, not logically every possible conscious authority.
component_assessments.component_confidence: Distinct normative warrant required; unique conscious grounding unsupported
component_assessments.reason: Conscious subjects make benefit and harm possible, but value, impartiality and authority require normative premises. Craig supplies a conditional nature/command account; Railton provides a developed naturalist rival without settling every categorical-reason question.

cross_component_assessments.assessment: A conscious primitive plus a specified grounding relation could explain concrete order, but why that primitive/relation exists remains a stopping-point question. Neither consciousness nor impersonal laws get a free exemption.
Worthwhile continuation can add goods conditional on actual survival, identity and value; endless duration alone is neither sufficient for value nor shown necessary for all meaning.
Finite benefits support finite meaning under an explicit value principle; this leaves enduring cosmic significance unanswered.
